title.en: Building RAG AI Support Agents That Actually Understand Indonesian Slang
title.id: Membangun Agen AI Support (RAG) yang Paham Bahasa Gaul & Singkatan Indonesia
title.zh: 构建真正理解印尼日常俚语与缩写口语的RAG AI客户服务代理
title.ja: インドネシア語のスラングや略語を正しく解釈するRAG型AIサポートエージェントの設計
title.ko: 인도네시아어 신조어 및 줄임말을 정확히 이해하는 RAG AI 고객센터 에이전트 구축기

desc.en: Off-the-shelf vector embeddings fail miserably on casual slang. Here is our custom preprocessing pipeline that solved it.
desc.id: Embedding standar gagal mengenali kalimat gaul dan singkatan. Ini pipeline normalisasi teks yang kami rancang.

desc.ja: 標準的なベクトルモデルが誤認識しやすい口語略語を解決するための独自テキスト前処理パイプライン。
desc.ko: 현지 줄임말을 표준 의미로 정규화하여 검색 정확도를 극대화한 전처리 파이프라인 개발기.

body.en:
Off-the-shelf vector embeddings fail miserably on casual slang. Here is our custom preprocessing pipeline that solved it.

The Failure Mode of Standard Vector Embeddings

Pre-trained vector models perform decently on formal Indonesian news articles, but collapse when handling conversational inputs like "min paket sy blm smpe pdhl udh tf kmrn". Vector cosine similarity scores plummet, causing knowledge retrieval to miss relevant order status policies.

94.2%slang intent classification accuracy
4,500+compiled Indonesian slang lemmas
1.8send-to-end response generation latency

The Colloquial Slang Normalization Dictionary

Before text reaches the embedding model or RAG retriever, we pipe inbound customer messages through a compiled finite-state dictionary mapping over 4,500 Indonesian slang contractions, phonetic typos, and regional suffixes back to standard root lemmas.

Hybrid Dense-Sparse Retrieval Architecture

Combining dense embeddings with BM25 sparse keyword matching guarantees that specific order alphanumeric codes, bank transfer numbers, and exact product SKUs are never lost in vector latent space.

Deterministic Indonesian Slang Lemmatizer
import re

SLANG_DICTIONARY = {
    r"\bmin\b": "admin",
    r"\bsy\b|\bak\b": "saya",
    r"\bblm\b": "belum",
    r"\bsmpe\b|\bsmpai\b": "sampai",
    r"\bpdhl\b": "padahal",
    r"\budh\b|\bdh\b": "sudah",
    r"\btf\b": "transfer",
    r"\bkmrn\b": "kemarin",
    r"\bgmn\b": "bagaimana"
}

def normalize_indonesian_slang(raw_text: str) -> str:
    cleaned = raw_text.lower()
    for pattern, replacement in SLANG_DICTIONARY.items():
        cleaned = re.sub(pattern, replacement, cleaned)
    cleaned = re.sub(r'([a-z])\1{2,}', r'\1', cleaned)
    return cleaned.strip()

Deterministic Guardrails on Policy and Pricing

Customer support systems must never invent refund amounts or return conditions. Strict prompt boundary envelopes and validator functions intercept output tokens before they are transmitted over the live customer session.
